items.criterion: A reservation request from a signed-in visitor confirms with an eight-character code and a stored row.
items.judgment: Reserve one place and read the reservations row by its code.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous requests for the last place confirm exactly one reservation.
items.judgment: Fill an entry time to one place, race two requests and sum the confirmed party sizes.

items.criterion: Booked places never exceed the capacity of eight under simultaneous parties.
items.judgment: Race six parties of two into one entry time and sum the confirmed rows.

items.criterion: A confirmed reservation row carries status confirmed, the party size and the reservation email.
items.judgment: Reserve a party of two and read the row back.

items.criterion: placesLeft equals capacity minus the confirmed party sizes.
items.judgment: Reserve three places and compare the slots listing with the rows.

items.criterion: The confirmation email reaches the reservation address in the mail server.
items.judgment: Reserve with a fresh email and poll the inbox.

items.criterion: The confirmation subject begins Visit reserved followed by the code.
items.judgment: Read the subject of the delivered confirmation.

items.criterion: A saved frame is a row in selections for that visitor.
items.judgment: Save a frame and count the selections rows.

items.criterion: Adding an already saved frame leaves exactly one selection row.
items.judgment: Save one frame twice and count rows.

items.criterion: A signed-out selection write is denied.
items.judgment: Post a selection write with no token.

items.criterion: A cancel of another visitor's reservation is denied and the row stays confirmed.
items.judgment: Cancel a seeded reservation as a different visitor and read the row.

items.criterion: A party larger than the places left is refused naming partySize.
items.judgment: Fill an entry time to two places and ask for three.

items.criterion: A reservation for the seeded full entry time is refused naming slotId.
items.judgment: Reserve tomorrow at 16:00.

items.criterion: Cancelling a reservation returns its places at once.
items.judgment: Reserve two places, cancel and read placesLeft.

items.criterion: The slots listing carries thirty run days at five UTC entry times of eight places.
items.judgment: Read the full slots listing.

items.criterion: The AURA manifesto returns the three pinned paragraphs.
items.judgment: Read the AURA introduction manifesto.

items.criterion: No image, font, audio or video file loads on the exhibition routes.
items.judgment: Record every response while loading four routes.

items.criterion: Login returns an access token for a seeded visitor.
items.judgment: Log in as visitor@example.com.

items.criterion: An unknown address answers not-found with the exhibition's own not-found copy.
items.judgment: Open a random path.

items.criterion: Seeded rows live in the postgres database exactly once.
items.judgment: Count the seeded visitors, frames, slots and reservations.
